title: Progress File for AI Agents: Never Lose Your Place
description:
Long tasks make AI agents forget where they were. A tiny file fixes that. 📝

✅ Write a PROGRESS.md checklist
✅ Tick off tasks and note what's next
✅ Run grep to find the next open task

Day 5 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 6, Make the Agent Verify Its Own Work.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

#shorts #aitools #coding #aicoding #aiagents #claudecode #programming
comment: Checklist or notes: which would you keep first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: end every session by updating the Next line, so a fresh agent knows exactly where to start.
